title: Hand the agent a video again: the panel composer takes clips by reference
description:
Fabio 2026-09-21, splitting MPI-797's close-out. MPI-797 Phase 3 deleted agent mode from MpiPromptBox, and `_sendAgentTurn` went with it - it was the ONLY UI path for handing the agent a video by reference. MPI-817's SERVER half is intact and still tested (routes/agent.js honours the path only inside the open project via agentCards.ownedMedia, `reference: true`, and the loop registers the clip under its basename as kind `result` so `generate` takes it as media and `make_gif` by item id). Nothing can reach any of it: the agent panel's composer, MpiAgentChat._addImageFile, guards on `image/` and silently ignores a dropped clip. So there is no way to hand the agent a video today.

This is a NEW SURFACE, not a patch - which is why it is its own card. MpiPromptBox staged its clip with a private `_importMediaFile`, there is NO shared import service, and MpiAgentChat has no project-media machinery at all. A clip can only travel by reference once it is a file the open project already holds (a gallery card, or a dropped file imported into it), so the composer needs a way to get there: extract the import into a shared service, or give the panel a card picker, or both. Decide that before building.

The contract is already written down and RED-by-design: the UI gate in tests/agent-video-attachment.test.cjs is a `todo` naming this gap (left as a todo rather than deleted, so it stays on the board every run). Making it pass is this card's definition of done. The shape it asserts is `{ url, name, mediaType: 'video', itemId }` - by reference, never a base64 data URL: a clip as bytes is hundreds of MB through a JSON body, which is the whole reason MPI-817 exists.

Read first: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-797/validation.md (the Phase 3 section records exactly what was removed and why restoring it is not a Phase 3 line), and tests/agent-video-attachment.test.cjs. Verify mode: user-ux - Fabio drops a clip on the agent panel and the agent can act on it.
